summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Admin User Management module. All backend APIs and frontend UI features working correctly.

minor.note: Known issue from previous iterations, does not affect core functionality

passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/users returns user list with all fields
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/stats returns correct user counts
✅ Backend: User filters (status, role, department, search) work correctly
✅ Backend: Authorization checks - non-admin users cannot access admin endpoints
✅ Frontend: User Management page loads at /admin/users
✅ Frontend: Stats cards display (17 Total, 7 Active, 3 Pending, 1 Inactive, 1 Recent Logins)
✅ Frontend: User list table shows Name, Email, Role, Department, Status, Last Login, Actions

✅ Frontend: Action menu shows Edit User, Activate (for inactive), Deactivate (for active non-super-admin)
✅ Frontend: Search filter works (searching 'admin' returns 2 users)
✅ Frontend: Status filter works (Active filter shows 7 users)
✅ Frontend: Role filter works (Super Admin filter shows 1 user)
